overview: Generate 10,000 purchase tokens in advance; a waiting room hands them out FIFO; holding a token lets the user check out normally.

estimation.assumption: Illustrative burst: 1M requests in 10 seconds for 10K units.
estimation.calculation: 1,000,000 / 10 = 100K requests/s; only 10K requests can win stock.
estimation.result: Reject or queue excess demand before durable order creation.
estimation.implication: Serve the sale page through CDN; use atomic admission and bounded queue consumers rather than a DB write for every click.

entityDetails.purpose: Exclusive admission to one unit of stock.
accessPatterns: Atomically claim an available unit; redeem or release by owner and lease version.
constraints: Check availability and decrement in one Lua operation; a release is idempotent and cannot resurrect sold stock.

accessPatterns: Create by reservation token; transition once to paid or expired.
constraints: UNIQUE(token_id) dedups queue deliveries; stock compensation follows an atomic order-state transition.

apiDetails.purpose: Reserve one unit and start asynchronous checkout.
apiDetails.rationale: Dedup requestId, enforce one purchase per policy, and return sold-out/admission responses explicitly.

steps.title: Shoppers → Gateway → FIFO waiting room → Sale Service → Purchase token ledger
steps.explanation: Queue admissions fairly, then claim exactly one of the preallocated stock tokens for a user and lease.

steps.title: Sale Service → Orders → Order workers → Orders DB
steps.explanation: Redeem the token into one durable order; duplicates return the original order.

steps.title: Unpaid sweeper → Orders DB
steps.explanation: Expire an unpaid order with an atomic state transition.

steps.title: Unpaid sweeper → Purchase token ledger
steps.explanation: Release only the matching unredeemed token version.

failureCases.scenario: Reservation succeeds but enqueue or order creation fails
failureCases.handling: Record an outbox or durable reservation reconciliation marker; retry with the same token. Release an expired unpaid token only after a fenced, idempotent order transition.

alternatives: Use an atomic stock counter for fast admission with robust reservation reconciliation. Use preallocated purchase tokens and a waiting room for bounded inventory and fair admission, accepting queued responses.
